eps.ov: Desir and the others counterattack Esteban in the Shadow World's Evernatten to correct mistakes in history.
Having solved the conflict with Esteban, Desir and the others now must solve the refugee crisis.
Desir and his party visit Prillecha Kingdom to do special training for the Yellow Ocean Championship.
While Romantica, Pram, and Azest advance in the championship, a man in a crow mask attacks the castle.
Desir and his team confront Batour, Talka, and Sharina, who seem to work under the Crow Mask.
Dadeinuf appears out of nowhere, and the Crow Mask attacks Desir and the others.
Desir faces the Crow Mask, and Zod clashes against Dadeinuf. Then, a bigger threat appears in front of Desir.
